name: Egyptian statutory labor-law floors and hour caps

payload.rationale: Egyptian labor baselines cap regular weekly hours at 48h, daily hours at 10h, enforce >= 11h rest between shifts, and grant >= 21/30 annual leave days.

response.expression: self.max_regular_weekly_hours <= 48 and self.max_daily_hours <= 10 and self.min_rest_between_shifts_hours >= 11 and self.standard_annual_leave_days >= 21 and self.senior_annual_leave_days >= 30

payload.subject: loc_eg.LaborProfile
